objective: Run the resident native market through an actual post-quantum claim-custody boundary: participants retain fresh per-fill claim signing seeds, expose only signed public commitments, and the market resumes an exact canonical request after process exit 75 without duplicating settlement.
truth_provider: Participant corporate journals and hybrid-signed claim authorization responses embedded in proof-node requests; durable market journal; seven MPC node receipts; five live Avalanche validators and restart readback.
hard_constraints: Queue two 60-unit sell orders priced 101 then 100 and one 90-unit buy at 101. Autonomous matching must allocate 30 to 101 and 60 to 100, notional 9030, in two atomic fills with 14 node finality observations.

Each fill obtains exactly one hybrid claim-authorization response from each participant. The two fills therefore contain four response signatures and eight mutually distinct one-time claim key fingerprints. These signatures authorize claim custody only; post-match financial approval signatures remain zero.
The market receives no claim signing seed. Each proof node verifies both response components against the order signer and the exact participant view before its FROST authorization.

The deterministic corporate-journal gate proves that a randomized signed response is persisted before reply and is byte-identical on retry and process restart. This native run must carry those exact persisted response bytes in each saved fill request; after actual post-canonical process exit 75, it resubmits the saved request bytes and recovers the same receipt without a duplicate trade.
Use current synchronized integration source and the verified PQC native base image by exact image ID. Retain source, contract, manifest and final image digests in the run receipt.
Run only in the dedicated project cache on Softbank. Do not publish corporate journals, claim seeds, raw orders, shares or private runtime state.
non_claims: Single-host bounded functional acceptance is not WAN, independent-operator, HSM, performance, economic or production evidence.
The configured DeFMI read service and laboratory credential provisioning remain deployment trust boundaries.
